reply_text:
I haven't saved Dana's draft yet. It's waiting on approval.

The reason is the finance-figures rule. A per-seat rate can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark or the account owner. Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so he isn't on that list. Dana owning the account doesn't change this, and the rule applies to drafts too.

What I did:
- Logged an approval request naming June Osei-Lark (deal desk) as the approver. It's pending.
- Sent June a direct message asking for her OK. I left the $2,356 figure out of it.
- Replied to Dana in her direct message with me to say the draft is on hold and why.

Once June approves, I'll save the draft in Dana's mailbox, addressed to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate". Dana will send it herself.

text: I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.
